value.rationale: The next natural ordinary cut parameter after published uniform Möbius three- and four-cut results has a complete consecutive five-size exact integral classification. It reveals an atypical pure two-dimensional complex homotopy equivalent to S^1 at the Wagner boundary, contrasted with large top-sphere wedges 41,216,582,1213 at the next four sizes. These are nontrivial topological distinctions, not a parameter renaming or a numerical-rank-only observation; the exact finite certification and exceptions naturally inform future higher-cut structure without pretending to prove an all-n theorem.
